$comment: The cloud cost run's executions (COST-0). plan.sh prices them, run.sh runs them in order (EXECUTIONS=name,name to pick). Each is one Cloud Run Job execution: `tasks` tasks of `cpu` vCPU / `memoryGiB` GiB, each running SLICES[task % length] with `parallel` tests at once. expectedMinutes is per task, from the local rehearsal (bench/cloud/testdata) with ~2x for cloud CPUs. `ai`: needs a model (author, heal).

executions.name: replay-correct-p1
executions.why: 10 replays of correct, one test at a time: replay $/test and the container start

executions.name: replay-correct-p4
executions.why: the same 10 replays, 4 tests at a time on the same shape

executions.name: replay-correct-small
executions.why: a smaller shape (1 vCPU / 2 GiB), one test at a time, to find the cheapest shape

executions.name: replay-variants
executions.why: every variant once (failing tests keep more evidence), failures mode

executions.name: evidence-modes
executions.why: evidence bytes by mode: full and minimal, a passing and a failing variant (two tasks in parallel)

executions.name: heal-cosmetic
executions.why: one cosmetic heal pass: no-AI heals, and the fixer where the model is in the cloud (AI_MODE=api)

executions.name: author-gold
executions.why: authoring the 11 gold tests in the cloud with the API key (AI_MODE=api only; with AI_MODE=local it runs on this Mac)
